verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents passing session cookies, or any authenticated-session input, so the API can fetch login-protected pages. The only nearby item is the screenshot guide's mention of handling 'target headers' (context-dev-docs-23). That is an adjacent control limited to screenshots and does not explicitly cover cookies or authenticated scraping. The 'authenticated API responses' and auth-flow items concern authenticating to Context.dev itself, not to target sites.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pass my own session cookies so the API fetches pages requiring authentication
